strings: m_c accepts the herbs from r_c0 for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} latest repeat stomachache. Both can only wish that it would prevent m_c from getting another one later.
m_c winces as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} roll over in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest. No matter the position, it doesn't help with the ache in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} stomach.
m_c feels bloated and overfull after just a small bit of prey.
Upon waking up, m_c knows it'll be a bad day. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} already {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} a bit queasy and unwell because of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} stomach.
